adaptation: CommonJS modules converted to ESM with named exports.
Filesystem helpers dropped from the format core: readSkillFile, scanSkillRoot and resolveInstalled are gone, so the port has no disk access and no dependency on the HNS installation directory.
extractTar was not carried over: this module inspects archives in memory and never writes files, which removes the extraction path entirely.
readSkillFile's size guard was folded into parseSkillText so a pasted document is bounded by the same MAX_SKILL_BYTES rule.
Archive inspection reports accepted/refused entries instead of returning a written-files list.
knownDifferences: No skill installation: wave 1 only validates and inspects.
readEntries filters unsafe paths out of the entry list (donor behaviour) instead of surfacing them as refused entries.
No GitHub download or source resolution: skill-source.js and skill-service.js are out of scope for wave 1.

vectors: skill name grammar (valid and invalid sets)
frontmatter subset: whenToUse, metadata, invocation booleans (all accepted spellings)
tar listing of regular files and directories with stripComponents
path traversal and absolute path refusal
